ltm rule event RADIUS AAA AUTH RESPONSE
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

RADIUS_AAA_AUTH_RESPONSE
       This event is raised when an authentication response arrives.

DESCRIPTION
       This event is raised when an authentication response arrives.

Examples
	when HTTP_REQUEST_DATA {
	    set aaa_result [AAA::auth_result $request_id]
	    if { $aaa_result == "INPROGRESS" } {
		after 200
		continue
	    }
	}
	when RADIUS_AAA_AUTH_RESPONSE {
	     log local0, "in RADIUS_AAA_AUTH_RESPONSE"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
       RADIUS_AAA_AUTH_REQUEST, RADIUS_AAA_ACCT_RESPONSE.

CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the event.
